claims: Wireless Festival 2026 is scheduled for July 10–12, 2026.
Wireless Festival 2026 is at Finsbury Park, London, UK.
Ye (formerly Kanye West) is booked for all three nights of Wireless Festival 2026.
Ye's performances at Wireless Festival 2026 mark his first UK performance in over a decade.
Pepsi and Diageo withdrew sponsorship from Wireless Festival 2026 following criticism from UK officials regarding Ye's past antisemitic remarks.
Pre-sale for Wireless Festival 2026 begins April 7 at 12 PM BST according to promotional materials.
General sale for Wireless Festival 2026 begins April 8 at 12 PM BST according to promotional materials.
Day passes for Wireless Festival 2026 are reported around £140.50.
Full weekends for Wireless Festival 2026 are reported at £360.50.
Prime Minister Keir Starmer described the booking of Ye for Wireless Festival 2026 as "deeply concerning".
Wireless Festival 2026 offers no camping facilities.
